text.tspan: 6.2 LEADER BOOKS A SLOT OR CANCELS IT

g.text: [Slot full or closed, or a meeting that day, or a review or defense at that time]

text.tspan: [Not CONFIRMED, meeting already started, or less than 2 hours before]
6.4 MINUTES: GENERATE, LEADER SUBMITS, INSTRUCTOR APPROVES

svg.text: Lock the schedule and the group
400 Finish or cancel that meeting first
Save booking (CONFIRMED), bookedCount + 1, slot FULL when no room left
Audit log, outbox BOOKING_CONFIRMED (notifies the instructor)
Booking CANCELLED, meeting CANCELLED, bookedCount - 1, slot AVAILABLE again
Save meeting (SCHEDULED) (400 if the booking is not CONFIRMED, 409 if one exists)
Status IN_PROGRESS (400 before the slot starts)
Log a requirement raised in the meeting
Save requirement (400 if the meeting is cancelled)
Status CONCLUDED, booking ATTENDED (the group may book again)
Read the notes and the requirements
Fill the template (Objectives, Discussion, New Requirements, Conclusion)
Save minutes as DRAFT (400 if already submitted or the notes are empty)
Status UNDER_REVIEW, studentSignedAt (409 if not DRAFT or REJECTED)
Status APPROVED or REJECTED, instructorSignedAt, audit log
